alternatives.option: Redesign handoffs around document-shaped payloads (markdown body or first-class doc references in the handoff record)
alternatives.reason_rejected: Duplicates what git + blackboard artifact entries already do well; adds API surface to a feature with zero organic usage.

alternatives.option: Remove the tools in v2.1 immediately
alternatives.reason_rejected: Removal is a breaking API change mid-2.x; deprecation now, removal at v3 respects semver.

context: Decided #33: retire the structured handoff surface at v3. twining_handoff/twining_acknowledge marked deprecated; plugin skills (twining-handoff, twining-dispatch, twining-coordinate) and BEHAVIORS.md rewritten around the committed-doc + artifact-pointer pattern. Plugin 1.15.0.
rationale: Field analysis: zero calls to the structured handoff API across 3 repos while the heaviest repo accumulated 40+ rich committed markdown handoff docs (26-87 KB) doing exactly this job — the structured API is too shallow for how projects actually hand off, and lite mode already hides it. Supersedes the 2026-02-18 decision to expose the CoordinationEngine handoff code as MCP tools rather than remove it: that bet was 'code exists, exposing completes the feature set', and five months of field data measured the result at zero adoption.
summary: Retire twining_handoff/twining_acknowledge at v3; v2.1 deprecates them and reorients all plugin guidance to the committed-doc + artifact-pointer handoff pattern
